name: sshd-config-weak
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: installs an sshd drop-in that weakens SSH (PermitRootLogin yes, PermitEmptyPasswords yes, X11Forwarding yes, AllowTcpForwarding yes) and restarts the service. Ensures the main config includes the drop-in dir. Paired checks read the effective values via `sshd -T`. No vars.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
d=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
install -d -m 0755 "$d"
cat > "$d/99-relay-weak.conf" <<'EOF'
PermitRootLogin yes
PermitEmptyPasswords yes
X11Forwarding yes
AllowTcpForwarding yes
EOF
if ! grep -qE '^\s*Include\s+/etc/ssh/sshd_config\.d' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  printf '\nInclude /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf\n' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
fi
systemctl restart ssh 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart sshd 2>/dev/null || true
